steps.title: Define protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Select the single‑channel pipette (Opentrons GEN1 or GEN2), upload a properly formatted .csv file that includes the header line, and specify source and destination labware names, their deck slot numbers, and the aspiration height (mm) for each transfer.

substeps.instruction: Choose pipette type (GEN1 or GEN2 single‑channel).
Create/upload a .csv file following the template and include the header line.
In the .csv, list source_labware and destination_labware using API names from the Labware Library.
Specify the deck slot for each labware.
Enter the aspiration height (mm) above the well bottom for each transfer.

steps.title: Place tip racks
steps.instruction: Insert tip racks into every deck slot that is not already occupied by source or destination labware.

steps.title: Aspirate liquid per CSV
steps.instruction: For each row in the CSV, the robot aspirates the indicated volume from the designated source labware and well, using the listed slot and the defined aspiration height above the well bottom.

steps.title: Dispense liquid per CSV
steps.instruction: Immediately after aspiration, the robot dispenses the aspirated volume into the specified destination labware and well, using the slot indicated in the CSV.

steps.title: Iterate through all transfers
steps.instruction: Repeat the aspirate and dispense steps for every line in the CSV until all transfers are completed.
